# Bulk SiO2 energy calculation

units metal
atom_style full
boundary p p p

read_data data.lmp

pair_style tersoff
pair_coeff * * /potentials/TERSOFF/2007_SiO.tersoff Si O

replicate 5 5 5

minimize ${etol} ${ftol} ${maxiter} ${maxeval}

variable natoms equal count(all)
variable ebulk equal pe/v_natoms

print "${ebulk}" file bulk_energy.txt

# Surface SiO2 energy calculation

units metal
atom_style full
boundary p p f

read_data data.lmp

pair_style tersoff
pair_coeff * * /potentials/TERSOFF/2007_SiO.tersoff Si O

replicate 5 5 5

minimize ${etol} ${ftol} ${maxiter} ${maxeval}

variable natoms equal count(all)
variable area equal lx*ly
variable esurf equal pe/v_natoms

print "${esurf}" file surface_energy.txt
print "${area}" file surface_area.txt

variable etol equal 1e-10
variable ftol equal 1e-10
variable maxiter equal 100000
variable maxeval equal 100000

include in.bulk

clear

variable etol equal 1e-10
variable ftol equal 1e-10
variable maxiter equal 100000
variable maxeval equal 100000

include in.surface

# Calculate surface energy
variable ebulk file bulk_energy.txt
variable esurf file surface_energy.txt
variable area file surface_area.txt

# Surface energy = (E_surf - E_bulk) * N_atoms / (2 * Area)
# Factor of 2 because we create two surfaces
variable gamma equal (v_esurf-v_ebulk)*v_natoms/(2.0*v_area)

print "${gamma}" file surface_energy_result.txt
